run_MessageFactory_GetPrototype: run MessageFactory.GetPrototype to dynamically create a protobuf message class from a descriptor
run_MessageFactory_GetMessages: run message_factory.GetMessages to generate all message classes from a list of FileDescriptorProtos
test_MessageFactory_duplicate_extension: test that MessageFactory raises an exception when two extensions use the same field number
test_MessageFactory_extensions: test setting and retrieving protobuf extensions on a dynamically generated message class
test_MessageFactory_serialization: test serializing and deserializing a dynamically generated protobuf message and verify round-trip equality
